items.name: audio-visualizer
items.title: Audio Visualizer
items.description: A mirrored waveform built on audvis, with an idle strip, reduced-motion support, and optional frequency samples.
items.docs: audvis, motion, and the cn utility are installed automatically. Import AudioVisualizer from your components directory and pass a caller-owned AnalyserNode or frequencyData (0–255) with isActive. For microphone input, use useAudioAnalyser from audvis in a client component; microphone access requires HTTPS or localhost and browser permission. See https://ui.jr7.dev/#audio-visualizer for a setup example.
